headline: Questions, quietly answered.
footer_note:
Didn't find it? More info drops closer to the gate!

For any other festival questions, please reach out to desertgreymusicfestival@gmail.com
For sponsor questions, please reach out to justin@berealnotright.com

items.question: What is Desert Grey Music Festival?
items.answer: Desert Grey Music Festival is a one-day Arizona music festival built around local and regional artists, community, and a bigger-stage festival experience. The festival is multi-stage, artist-forward, and focused on celebrating the rising Arizona music scene.

items.question: When and where is Desert Grey Music Festival?
items.answer:
Desert Grey Music Festival happens Saturday, October 3, 2026 at The Nile Theater, 105 W Main St, Mesa, AZ 85201.

Doors open at 2:00 PM. Music runs across three stages — Main, Underground, and Coffee Shop — until 11:00 PM.

items.question: Who's playing?
items.answer:
25+ bands across three stages. Also featured are brand, sponsors, and vendor booths. The lineup drops in waves from now until the week of the show!

Follow @desertgreymusicfestival for announcements.

items.question: How much are tickets, and what do bundles include?
items.answer: Tickets go on sale Friday, June 12, 2026 via the official Desert Grey website and ticket link on PurplePass. Early Bird tickets are $20 the first week only — limited quantity. Day-of door price is $30. Package items will be available for pickup at the festival.  If not picked up day of festival, they will be shipped out to the purchaser in the week following the festival.

items.question: Is the festival all-ages?
items.answer:
Yes. Desert Grey Music Festival is planned as an all-ages event.

Guests must be 21+ and have a valid ID to purchase alcohol. Parents and guardians should use their own judgment for younger fans, and ear protection is strongly recommended for kids.

items.question: What is the bag policy?
items.answer:
The Nile has a clear bag policy for shows.

Bring a small clear bag if possible, and avoid backpacks, large bags, or anything that may slow down entry. All bags may be checked by security.

items.question: What's the schedule? When does my favorite band play?
items.answer:
Doors are currently planned for 2:00 PM on Saturday, October 3, 2026.

The first wave of bands will be announced on Friday, June 19, 2026

Final set times and stage schedules will be announced closer to the festival. We keep set times confidential until close to the festival to encourage cross-stage discovery. Every band on this lineup brings something worth catching.

items.question: Can I watch the livestream if I can't make it?
items.answer:
Yes. We're livestreaming all three stages through the official Desert Grey Discord. Stream pass access is $10 and includes:

- Discord invite to all 3 stages
- Real-time chat with other fans and bands
- 10% off festival merch during the stream
- 72 hours of replay access after the festival

items.question: What's the Battle of the Bands and the Festival Giveaway?
items.answer:
Battle of the Bands is a campaign within the festival. Local and regional bands apply between June 10 and July 5, contestants get voted on by fans through July and August, and the winner earns a Main Stage slot at Desert Grey 2026.

The festival giveaway runs throughout festival day. At the festival, you will be able to purchase as many giveaway entries as you would like! We pull around 8-10 drawings during the festival for sponsor-donated prizes and gift bags including: experiences, gift cards, branded gear. Winners are announced live on the main stage throughout the day!

items.question: Can I bring outside food or drink?
items.answer:
Plan on no outside food or drinks unless the venue specifically announces an exception.

Food and drinks are expected to be available through The Nile/The Underground/The Nile Coffee Shop and approved festival vendors. Water, food, and drink details will be posted closer to the festival.

Alcohol will only be available to guests with valid ID who are 21+.

items.question: Can I transfer my ticket?
items.answer:
If you have a digital ticket, you may give the ticket to someone else, but only the first valid scan will work. Do not post your ticket or QR code publicly.

If your ticket is at will call, the original purchaser may need the matching ID and payment card, so contact Purplepass or the festival team ahead of time if someone else needs to pick it up.

Desert Grey is not responsible for third-party resale issues, duplicate screenshots, or tickets bought from unofficial sellers.

All sales are generally final.

Refunds, exchanges, or credits are only handled in limited situations, such as if the event is canceled, postponed, or significantly changed, and those decisions are controlled by the event organizer and ticketing policies.
items.question: Are tickets refundable?
What happens if it rains?
items.answer:
Desert Grey is planned inside The Nile Theater, The Underground, and Nile Coffee Shop, so the festival is expected to continue rain or shine unless the venue or festival team announces otherwise.

Rain by itself does not automatically mean the event is canceled or refundable.

items.question: Is The Nile accessible?
items.answer:
The Nile Theater’s main theater space and coffee shop are wheelchair accessible. The Underground is only accessible by stairs, but venue staff may be able to help with accommodations.

Anyone who needs accessibility support should contact the venue before the festival.

items.question: Where should I park?
items.answer:
Parking is available behind The Nile Theater, along with available street parking in downtown Mesa.

Plan to arrive early, especially if you want to catch the first bands.

items.question: Where do I find official updates?
items.answer:
Official updates will be shared through the Desert Grey website, ticket page, and social media.

Use the official ticket link when buying tickets, and avoid unofficial resale links or screenshots from people you do not know.
